item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "c076d8eeb4896795baa87847308d3da21a21f9962d44b53743b8124b74ab38a6",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a real-parameter function q with values in a real normed vector space, there exist vectors qt and qx which are respectively the derivatives of τ ↦ q(x,τ) at t and ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) at x, and satisfy qt + speed • qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Its negation at speed 1, x = 0, t = 1 denies the simultaneous existence of both partial derivatives satisfying qt + qx = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Every spatial slice is interval integrable between arbitrary real endpoints, every temporal flux slice is interval integrable between arbitrary real endpoints, and for all a,b,s,t the spatial integral at t minus that at s equals the time integral from s to t of flux(q(a,τ)) − flux(q(b,τ)).",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts these two integrability conditions and the integral balance identity for the specified function with identity flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "LocalDef003(v,τ,x,t) is LocalDef005(v,x,t−τ), a time translation by τ.",
      "effect_on_target": "With τ = 1, the moving discontinuity lies on x = t−1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication is continuous in every real normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuous scalar multiplication structure required for the derivative predicates in LocalDef001; it imposes no additional hypothesis on v.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Transports at speed 1 the profile which is 0 to the left of the origin, valueAtJump at the origin, and 1 to the right.",
      "effect_on_target": "Together with the time translation, specifies the target function completely.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "Given three states, returns the left state for a negative real argument, the right state for a positive argument, and the designated origin value for zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Sets q_v(x,t) to 0 when x < t−1, to 1 when x > t−1, and to v when x = t−1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a profile at x−speed·t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Introduces transport with speed +1, before the time shift.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the addition, zero, associativity, and commutativity of an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive commutative monoid structure used by the real module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group underlying an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition, subtraction, and negation in the structural instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition, subtraction, and negation structure of an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the ordinary additive operations underlying the real-valued expressions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and its two-sided zero identity from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible addition and zero in the module instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished zero from an addition-with-zero structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same real zero used in scalar and additive structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Retains the addition and zero operations from a structure asserting their identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real additive operations during instance conversion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction: both constituent propositions hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all three main conclusions, and all components of the integral balance property, simultaneously.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field supplies a normed field with nontrivial norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar-field structure required for differentiation over the reals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible real scalar multiplication in the derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real module action to the scalar multiplication used by continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring underlying a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real semiring operations needed to form the module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains the commutative semiring and division structure of a field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an intermediate real algebraic structure without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the neighborhood of that point and a fixed base point in the derivative filter.",
      "effect_on_target": "For the real functions here, means ordinary two-sided real differentiation, both for partial slices and for the spatial integral as a function of time.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector space structure underlying an inner product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the real codomain a normed vector space over the reals for integrals and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A topology satisfying the module-topology condition has continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuous scalar multiplication for the real derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Continuous ring operations supply the corresponding continuous semiring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the standard real topological ring to its scalar-action continuity structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring, viewed as a module over itself, satisfies the module-topology condition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate justification of continuous real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure of a measure space.",
      "effect_on_target": "All integrability assertions and integrals use the volume measure selected by Real.measureSpace.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action of the reals on themselves.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts multiplication and its identity and associativity from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar multiplicative monoid for the real module action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the nonunital commutative ring operations while forgetting the associativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an underlying real ring structure used in topological instance conversion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital, possibly nonassociative ring structure while forgetting commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the algebraic structure required by the topological ring predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital commutative ring underlying a normed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains ordinary real ring operations in the continuity instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts a nonunital seminormed ring while forgetting commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate structure for the real additive seminorm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and compatible pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive seminormed structure used by the real normed-space instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field underlying a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real field and norm used in differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains norm, addition, and pseudometric from a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive seminormed structure for the real normed vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring operations and metric while forgetting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an underlying real ring structure without altering topology or arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the ring, norm, and compatible pseudometric of a normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the seminormed real ring used by topology and module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field operations and laws from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real field arithmetic in the structural chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the commutative ring, norm, and metric of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real normed ring underlying the scalar topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the scalar action used in real differentiation and the equation qt + speed • qx = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Not",
      "meaning": "Negation of a proposition is its implication to falsehood.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denies the pointwise derivative-and-equation property and denies each proposed derivative of the integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Extracts the interpretation of a natural-number literal in the designated type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets all displayed 0 and 1 constants as real numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "One.toOfNat1",
      "meaning": "Interprets the literal 1 as the distinguished multiplicative identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the real unit used for speed, time shift, evaluation time, right state, and upper integration endpoint.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure of a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Contributes the usual real topology used for derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Equips a real-or-complex-like field with its real inner product space structure, using its existing normed algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "At Real, supplies its ordinary normed vector space structure over itself.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All state values, coordinates, times, endpoints, speeds, and derivative candidates in the target are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field with the density property for its norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a nontrivially normed scalar field for ordinary real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the addition used in the real scalar-action and topological structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition, zero, negatives, and subtraction for real derivatives and integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.instOne",
      "meaning": "The real multiplicative identity 1.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines all occurrences of the real constant 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The real-or-complex-like structure on Real, with real-part map equal to identity, imaginary-part map zero, and the identity real normed algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the standard real inner product and normed-space structures; it introduces no complex-valued variables.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real additive identity 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the left state, spatial evaluation point, lower integration endpoint, and equation's zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The selected measure-space instance on Real; its displayed body delegates selection to instance inference.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the measure μ used throughout. The packet does not unfold this instance far enough to verify its normalization directly.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive commutative group equipped with its norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the normed real codomain for the functions, integrals, and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Real ring arithmetic with its norm and compatible metric, satisfying the norm bound for multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real normed-space and topological structures without additional target assumptions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its compatible metric and multiplicative norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar field and norm for all derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric structure with distance |x−y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes neighborhoods and derivative limits use the ordinary real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure on Real supplied by instance inference.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real module-topology instance with the usual real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from an action preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar operation whose continuity is used by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains semiring operations and division from a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an intermediate scalar structure in the real module instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the seminorm, ring operations, and pseudometric while forgetting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real additive seminorm and topology used in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring underlying a commutative one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real normed ring to its pseudometric.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the compatible pseudometric of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar topology used in continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains multiplication, one, zero, and their monoid-with-zero laws from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative monoid for the scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid underlying the subtraction-and-negation structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the addition and zero used by scalar-action structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the topology used in HasDerivAt to the one induced by the real metric.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the literal 0 as the distinguished zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the target's zero literals are ordinary real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "id",
      "meaning": "The identity function, sending each argument to itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "The flux is exactly flux(u) = u, so boundary flux differences are q(a,τ)−q(b,τ).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The reals form a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of real ring operations and hence the scalar-action continuity required for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "intervalIntegral",
      "meaning": "The integral over (a,b] with respect to μ minus the integral over (b,a] with respect to μ.",
      "effect_on_target": "All integrals are oriented interval integrals; for endpoints 0 and 1 this is the integral over (0,1].",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Builds a commutative subtraction monoid from an additive commutative group using its existing subtraction and negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports subtraction and zero structures in the local definitions without changing real arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the addition operation in qt + speed • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Retains associative, commutative addition from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate structure for the addition in the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and its commutativity from an additive commutative semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the additive group structure to the displayed addition operation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the extended seminormed additive commutative monoid structure from an extended normed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the extended-norm structure used in interval integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid underlying an extended seminormed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible additive operations in the integrability structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the extended seminormed additive monoid while forgetting commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an underlying extended seminorm structure for integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid underlying an extended seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition and zero in the integrability instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires exact equality in the integral balance and in the zero derivative combination.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "LocalDef001 asks for derivative witnesses qt and qx for the same q, speed, x, and t; the target negates existence of such a pair.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation from a heterogeneous-addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "At the target's real specialization, expresses ordinary addition of the derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a heterogeneous scalar-action instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses multiplication of the spatial derivative by speed 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts subtraction from a heterogeneous-subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses the time shift, differences of spatial integrals, and differences of boundary fluxes.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "The function is integrable on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the specified measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires integrability on every bounded spatial interval at each time and on every bounded temporal interval at each position, with no endpoint-order assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure whose negation preserves zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the codomain zero appearing in the local derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A commutative additive group with a norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "The local definitions allow such codomains generally, but the target fixes the codomain to Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative group underlying a normed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides algebraic operations on the derivative and integral values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
